subtree.description: Channel path and all its descendants.

labels.description: Root-label filter: key to accepted values ([] = key present). Values for one key are ORed; keys are ANDed. Keys are case-insensitive; abby.task.state may be used.

assignee.description: eligible: unassigned or assigned to the caller; me: assigned to the caller; unassigned: no assignee.

lease_seconds.description: Lease length in seconds. Default limits.claim_lease_default_seconds; outside [limits.claim_lease_min_seconds, limits.claim_lease_max_seconds] is 400 validation_failed, never clamped (CLAIM-020).

wait_ms.description: 0..limits.max_claim_wait_ms. Wait for a candidate without holding a lock (SEL-006).
